# Template: todos.md (machine view)

The unfinished-work ledger, compiled.

**Verdict: script-perfect.** The marker contract is line-leading
`TODO` and `! ` (no false-positive pruning, no interpretation); this
view is the writing-facing inventory, not an audit gate.

## Format

```markdown
<!-- Machine view. Generated by compile.sh at <stamp> from a scan of
     paper.tex + the prose .tex files. REGENERATE: sh
     scripts/compile.sh. -->

# Open to-dos (N)

| Where | Marker | Text |
|---|---|---|
| sections/1_intro/intro.tex:4 | TODO | introduce the MACRO project. |
```

## Source & regeneration

`grep -n '^TODO\|^! '` over `paper.tex` + the prose .tex files.
`sh scripts/compile.sh todos`.
